text:
Maya: Quick sync — running a 'go-live wargame' today 3pm PT to exercise marketplace listing, press timing, SI handoffs, and hardware partner callbacks. Need everyone who is owning an action in the runbook to join. :spiral_calendar:

Evan: I'll be there. I'll run listing verification and demo checkout flow from staging to prod-mirror.

Sofia: I'll own press embargo choreography and blog publish gating. Can we confirm embargo window?

Raj: SI lead here — we'll test the onboarding flow and the provisioning webhook. Want to run a full tenant provision + config push in the dry-run.

Olivia: Legal heads-up: press copy needs one final sentence on data residency for dedicated customers. I'll drop the approved snippet before the call.

Maya: Nice. Agenda: 1) Listing pipeline smoke (Evan) 2) Landing page switch and CDN purge (webops) 3) Press embargo and blog publish (Sofia + Olivia) 4) SI provisioning and rollback (Raj) 5) Hardware partner availability check (Vendor ops) 6) Postmortem cadence and issue triage hooks. 45m total.

Evan: For the listing smoke I'd like to run this curl: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://marketplace.staging.redwood.ai/v1/catalogs/our-product` then `jq .status` to validate `published` flag. Will also open a quick Harness pipeline to flip the staging->mirror alias.

Sofia: Embargo window proposal: press embargo lifts 10:00am PT Tue. We need final assets + code snippet by EOD today. If legal approves earlier, we slide embargo to 9:00am to hit APAC morning.

Olivia: Approved snippet (final): "Redwood Inference's dedicated offering can be deployed in customer VPCs with configurable KMS integration for key management." Use exact wording.

Raj: On the SI side, test matrix: 1) Tenant create via API 2) Provision GPU pool 3) Hand off to provisioning webhook 4) Validate model pull + init. If step 3 fails, our rollback is `POST /provision/rollback` with body `{tenant_id}`. I'll paste runbook on the call.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Dry-run pipeline scheduled: `marketplace/dryrun-listing/2025-11-03-15:00` (status: queued).

Maya: Hardware partners — can someone confirm the on-call window for partner XYZ? We need an escalation if the hardware image fails to boot during SI onboarding.

Evan: I pinged Jason at HW-partner earlier; he confirmed standby until 6pm PT. I'll add him to the call.

Sofia: Blog plan: 1) Launch blog (product + customer benefits) 2) Partner callout section 3) Quickstart (snippet + curl) 4) FAQ including SLA/regions. I'll attach the draft.

Olivia: Also request: marketing to avoid a sentence implying a guaranteed 99.99% SLA without the SLA doc link. We need the SLA doc linked on the landing page.

Maya: Good catch. Action owners: Evan (listing smoke + alias flip), Sofia (press + blog), Raj (SI dry-run + rollback), Olivia (legal snippet + SLA link), Jason/HW (hardware standby).

Evan: For the alias flip I'll use this Harness step: `step: swap-alias from=staging to=mirror-prod` then run smoke tests against `https://mirror-prod.redwood.ai/checkout`. If any smoke test fails, revert alias and notify #eng-runtime.

Raj: We'll simulate a provisioning webhook failure by returning 500 in the mock upstream for 2 minutes to test rollback and retry logic. Please ensure the retry window is set to 5m in staging.

Sofia: PR for blog draft: https://git.internal.redwood/marketing/ops/pulls/472 — please review before 5pm.

Olivia: Uploaded the legal-approved snippet to the PR. Also added a short FAQ entry about data residency and encryption at rest.

Maya: On-call contact list for the wargame: Evan (listing), Raj (SI), Jason (HW-partner), Priya (webops CDN), Sofia (marketing), Olivia (legal). I'll post it in #general and ping everyone 10m before.

Evan: One more: we should validate our usage quotas on the dedicated test account to avoid rate limits during the demo. I'll run `curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/quotas -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"`.

Raj: Noted. Also remind SIs to clear caches post-provision so KV cache doesn't leak test prefixes into production. We'll run a `POST /cache/clear` during the dry-run.

Maya: If everything is green after the wargame, our tentative publish timeline: Thursday morning docs + blog, Friday listing in cloud marketplaces (AWS + GCP), and Monday dedicated capacity starts onboarding for customers. This is flexible depending on embargo and partner readiness.

Sofia: Can marketing commit to the Thursday timeline for the blog?

Olivia: Legal cleared for Thursday publish as long as embargo timing holds and the SLA link is live.

Evan: I'll have the listing smoke done by 2:30pm so we can iterate on any fixes before 3pm call.

Maya: Perfect. Final ask: anyone who can't make the 3pm wargame drop a note here with what you own and a delegate. Otherwise see you on the call. :white_check_mark:

Raj: I'll be on the call. I'll add a short runbook snippet to Confluence with the rollback commands and the test matrix after the call.

Sofia: Attending. I'll bring final asset checklist and embargo timeline.

Evan: On my way.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Reminder: dry-run pipeline starting in 10 minutes.
